# Certified Payments

> > Certified Payments provides government payment processing services and tax payment portals across the United States, operated by Accelerated Card Company, LLC in partnership with Fifth Third Bank.

The platform offers multiple payment portals including Quick STI for tax and service payments, consumer payment lookup tools, and comprehensive payment history tracking for government transactions. The site is currently transitioning from legacy Quick STI systems to modernized payment infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Certified Payments
- Accelerated Card Company, LLC
- Fifth Third Bank
- Quick STI
- Government payment processing
- Tax payment portals
- Consumer payment lookup
- Credit card processing
- Bureau code payments
- STI payment services
- Payment history tracking
- Teller login systems
- Service payments
- Site migration and decommissioning

## Payment Portals

- [Certified Payments](http://certifiedpayments.net/): Homepage for government payment processing services across the US
- [Quick STI Payment Portal](https://quicksti.certifiedpayments.net/): Quick STI payment portal for tax and service payments via Fifth Third Bank
- [Consumer Payment Lookup](https://payments.certifiedpayments.net/Consumer/Payments): Consumer payment lookup and transaction history search portal

## Support and System Notices

- [Session Timeout](https://certifiedpayments.net/sti/stiquick/Timeout.aspx): Session timeout page with Quick STI decommissioning notice
